title.tr: Odun fırınlı dış mutfak ve deck zemin
title.en: Outdoor kitchen with a wood-fired oven on a deck

alt.tr: Çıtalı duvarın önünde odun fırını, ocak ve paslanmaz buzdolaplı dış mutfak; solda masa köşesi
alt.en: Outdoor kitchen with a wood-fired oven, a stove and a stainless fridge in front of a slatted wall, a table corner on the left

caption.tr: Siyah odun fırını ortada, yanında ocak ve fırın var. Sağda paslanmaz çelik iki kapaklı buzdolabı duruyor, zemin deck.
caption.en: The black wood-fired oven sits in the middle with a stove and an oven beside it. A two-door stainless steel fridge stands on the right and the floor is decking.
